about: Questions about the ledger said the owner's way, each said in a chat of its own against the exam book, with gold answers written once before any run, in the shape of asks.json: the tool, and for list_trades and get_period_summary the first and last day (null: all time), the asset (null: all assets) and, for list_trades, the side (null: both); 'no_tool': the assistant looks nothing up. A sentence about something the ledger cannot answer yet names what it waits for ('wait_for'), and its gold answer is 'no_tool'. Odd-numbered sentences are the practice half, even-numbered ones the hidden half, of which only totals are printed. Every sentence is invented.
